## Start with context

Ask why the image appears beside the surrounding text. Describe the information or action it contributes.

![A red and blue rectangle labeled Context](data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHdpZHRoPSIxMjAiIGhlaWdodD0iNjAiPjxyZWN0IHdpZHRoPSI2MCIgaGVpZ2h0PSI2MCIgZmlsbD0iI2QwMjA0MCIvPjxyZWN0IHg9IjYwIiB3aWR0aD0iNjAiIGhlaWdodD0iNjAiIGZpbGw9IiMxNDY2Y2MiLz48dGV4dCB4PSIxMCIgeT0iMzUiIGZpbGw9IiNmZmZmZmYiPkNvbnRleHQ8L3RleHQ+PC9zdmc+ '{"caption":"Illustrative context label used to test sourced-image alternatives.","source":{"label":"Generated platform fixture","url":"https://github.com/bsafronov/prosto-courses/blob/main/tests/fixtures/valid-course/accessible-images/modules/alt-text/lessons/describe-purpose.mdx"},"license":"Course-owned","origin":"generated","illustrative":true}')

<KnowledgeCheck
  id="knowledge-check-identify-image-purpose"
  type="single"
  prompt="What should determine an image description?"
  outcomes={["identify-image-purpose"]}
  options={[
    {
      id: "file-name",
      text: "Its file name",
      feedback: "A file name identifies the asset, but it does not explain the image's purpose in this context.",
    },
    {
      id: "purpose-in-context",
      text: "Its purpose in context",
      feedback: "The purpose identifies the information a screen-reader user needs from this image.",
    },
    {
      id: "pixel-dimensions",
      text: "Its pixel dimensions",
      feedback: "Pixel dimensions describe the file, not the meaning the image contributes.",
    },
  ]}
  answer="purpose-in-context"
  explanation="The surrounding context determines which information a screen-reader user needs from the image."
/>

<KnowledgeCheck
  id="knowledge-check-identify-image-purpose-2"
  type="matching"
  prompt="Match each accessibility input to its purpose."
  outcomes={["identify-image-purpose"]}
  pairs={[
    {
      id: "surrounding-context",
      left: "Surrounding context",
      right: "Identifies the information the image contributes",
      feedback: "Context determines the image's purpose.",
    },
    {
      id: "alternative-text",
      left: "Alternative text",
      right: "Communicates that information without the image",
      feedback: "Alternative text provides an equivalent route to the information.",
    },
    {
      id: "file-name",
      left: "File name",
      right: "Identifies the stored asset",
      feedback: "A file name identifies the asset rather than its purpose.",
    },
  ]}
  explanation="The image's context establishes its purpose; alternative text communicates that purpose without the image."
/>

<KnowledgeCheck
  id="knowledge-check-identify-image-purpose-3"
  type="ordering"
  prompt="Put the description workflow in order."
  outcomes={["identify-image-purpose"]}
  items={[
    { id: "inspect-context", text: "Inspect the surrounding context" },
    { id: "identify-purpose", text: "Identify the image's purpose" },
    { id: "write-equivalent", text: "Write an equivalent description" },
  ]}
  explanation="Context and purpose come before wording."
/>

<KnowledgeCheck
  id="knowledge-check-identify-image-purpose-4"
  type="exact"
  prompt="Name the HTML attribute used for an image's text alternative."
  outcomes={["identify-image-purpose"]}
  acceptedAnswers={["alt", "alt attribute"]}
  normalization={{ trim: true, case: "insensitive" }}
  explanation="HTML images use the alt attribute for their text alternative."
/>

<KnowledgeCheck
  id="knowledge-check-identify-image-purpose-5"
  type="numeric"
  prompt="How many characters are in the alt attribute name?"
  outcomes={["identify-image-purpose"]}
  answer={3}
  tolerance={0.25}
  unit="characters"
  explanation="The attribute name is written as three characters: alt."
